QuestInfo.name: [Lachelein] The Second Music Box
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Watermelon Mask in the hideout about the music box.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to Watermelon Mask about the music box.
QuestInfo.2: The second music box was located in the Lachelein Ballroom.

0.msg: #bDo you remember anything about the music box?

1.msg: #bA Music box?#k You know... maybe I woke up because you destroyed it. Ah!

2.msg: I remember. I heard the same sound from far away, even after the music box was destroyed. But once I had fully awoken, it was gone.

3.msg: #b(I should tell Gray Mask what I've learned here.)

yes.0: It was coming from... Lachelein Ballroom.

no.0: Weren't you going to tell Gray Mask?

0.msg: You found the #blocation of the second music box#k? That's great!

1.msg: So, the music box was located in the #bLachelein Ballroom#k. There is hope after all. We'll be able to liberate this city if we carry on and destroy the music boxes.

2.msg: It's too early to jump to conclusions.

3.msg: Lucid has not made a move, and the Dreamkeepers are holding back...

4.msg: We still don't know what it takes to #rdefeat Lucid#k.

5.msg: You're right. We need to be careful until we know more.

yes.0: You have another part to play.

0.msg: You know... Weren't you going to tell Gray Mask?
